description: MainActivity.java for an Android app demonstrating MediaRouter API usage to display content on a secondary display using Presentation. Manages media routes, updates presentation display, and handles user interactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Activity demonstrating secondary display routing and presentation management using MediaRouter API.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, retrieves views, and sets up MediaRouter.

methods.name: updatePresentation
methods.description: Updates or creates a presentation on a secondary display based on current media route.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers media route callback and updates presentation state.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Dismisses active presentation when activity stops.

methods.name: showNextColor
methods.description: Cycles to the next background color on the secondary display.
